title: Far Ocean, Low Signal
note: A submerged radio hymn: patient sub-bass, corroded piano, distant hydrophone clicks, no obvious resolution.

title: Lamp After Everyone Leaves
note: A tiny domestic machine groove: dry relay clicks, warm current hum, one hook flickering like a lamp refusing sleep.

title: Tatami Weather
note: Morning air crossing an empty tatami room: glass harmonics, brushed pulse, soft wood resonance, gradually lifting.

title: Window With No Building
note: Make the room outside the window feel larger than the city: bowed metal, tape piano, slow gravity, unresolved.

title: Cabin Receiving
note: An off-grid broadcast finds a dance beat: clipped kick, shortwave grit, wooden percussion, bright two-note reply.

title: Fuji in the Rearview
note: A road memory becoming weightless: granular bells, motorik-soft drums, silver guitar, horizon opening.

title: Pier at 4:17 AM
note: Wet timber, black water, one sodium lamp: deep bass tide, sparse piano, cable groans, patient silence.

title: Neon Is a Weather System
note: Treat neon as rain: hard little drums, chromatic bass, electrical spray, one impossible pop hook.

title: Chapel for Machines
note: A gentle service for obsolete devices: glass choir, soft breaks, transformer hum, an upward melodic release.

title: Sail Beyond Reception
note: A sail crosses out of network range: clipped rhythm dissolving into open bells, wind-like guitar, clean final lift.
